name: std::set<Key,Compare,Allocator>::insert_range

declarations.code:
template <container - compatible - range<value_type> R>

void insert_range(R &&rg);

intro:
Inserts a copy of each element in the range rg if and only if there is no element with key equivalent to the key of that element in *this.

Each iterator in the range rg is dereferenced exactly once.
The behavior is undefined if rg overlaps with the container.

No iterators or references are invalidated.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
rg

 -

 a container compatible range, that is, an input_range whose elements are convertible to T


 Type requirements


 -value_type must be EmplaceConstructible into set from *ranges::begin(rg). Otherwise, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: N·log(a.size() + N), where N is ranges::distance(rg).
